supabase/infrastructure ships the v2 notebook routes ahead of the platform. Pinned here so `supabase notebooks push/pull` has a typed client; the paired remove keeps the add idempotent once the deployed spec carries them, at which point this whole block should be deleted rather than left masking upstream.

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of the project notebooks. Notebook bodies are omitted — read a single notebook to get its cells.

post.description: Creates a notebook shared with everyone who has access to the project. Cell ids are assigned by the server and returned in the response.

patch.description: Updates the attributes provided and leaves the rest untouched. Sending `content` replaces the whole notebook body.

400.description: The request references a cell that does not exist on this notebook
